coverage.row: The disabled V8 global is absent, fallback works, and direct fixed and growable construction produce ReferenceError.
Shared wasm backing stores from JS memory and grown module-exported memory raise the named gap.
Runtime views expose ordinary backing stores and ordinary ArrayBuffer prototype constructors.
Ordinary wasm and the ordinary-view Atomics operations retain live Node semantics.
Packaged README code selects restricted, omitted and explicit-allow guests in fresh contexts.
The complete corpus retains live Node behavior and declared ceilings with omitted and explicit true.
Allow and default retain growable shared buffers, Atomics and shared wasm behavior.
Opposite choices stay independent on sequential and overlapping calls to one warm worker.
A restricted call keeps its policy after worker loss and a solo retry.
runCode accepts the optional boolean and rejects invalid values.
The pre-load GuestHost option selects policy and the packed embedder rejects invalid values.
The pinned wasm prototype surface includes the three covered producers. Ordinary conversions retain callable method identity by name and non-constructability.
All three wasm producers distinguish ordinary and shared backing stores under guest replacement of the selected intrinsics.
Restricted bootstrap removes the original global before runtime captures it and performs only its own early native wasm memory lookup.
